summary: quorvex ships hidden Windows PE dropped to disk on import
details: quorvex@0.2.0 advertises itself in its README as an empty placeholder package with 'nothing in here yet', but its main module index.mjs contains a large chunked base64 array constant (P1) whose bytes decode to a Windows PE executable (MZ header and 'This program cannot be run in DOS mode' marker present). The package sets sideEffects:true so the module is retained by bundlers, and at module top level it base64-decodes P1 and writes the resulting executable to disk via writeFileSync at a computed exePath. The embedded executable is undocumented, its purpose is not disclosed, and it is delivered to the installer's filesystem as a side effect of importing an ostensibly empty package. The chunked-base64-array encoding of the PE is structural obfuscation that hides the payload from casual inspection.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
